notes: Textos copiados literalmente dos prints do Google. 'quote' é o trecho para o site: só cortes marcados com '…', nenhuma palavra trocada.
location 'unknown' = não dá para saber a loja pelo print; o card mostra só 'Google review', sem tag de loja, até o dono confirmar.
Não exibir datas. Não usar AggregateRating/Review em JSON-LD (auto-avaliação é ignorada/penalizada pelo Google em negócio local).
O lote 2 repetiu os mesmos 11 prints do lote 1; não houve avaliações novas.

reviews.name: Alexandra
reviews.quote: A lovely, small and cosy café with a warm, colourful atmosphere. The staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming, making us feel at home from the moment we walked in.
reviews.fullText: A lovely, small and cosy café with a warm, colourful atmosphere. The staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming, making us feel at home from the moment we walked in. The coffee was excellent, and the cake was absolutely delicious. I will definitely be coming back and will happily recommend this place to everyone looking for a great coffee and a relaxing atmosphere!

reviews.name: Claire
reviews.quote: Lovely little cafe with really friendly staff. I had a coconut flat white, which was excellent. There's a great selection of pastries and sweets to choose from.
reviews.fullText: Lovely little cafe with really friendly staff. I had a coconut flat white, which was excellent. There's a great selection of pastries and sweets to choose from. Seating is available both indoors (a few single seats) and outside, making it a nice spot to sit and enjoy. Overall, a really pleasant place to visit if you're in the area

reviews.name: Lydia O.
reviews.quote: Lovely flat white. Staff nice. … Had my small dog with me & she seemed welcome
reviews.fullText: Lovely flat white. Staff nice. Sat in for a few minutes to enjoy my coffee as it was a cold day. Had my small dog with me & she seemed welcome (there was a dog water bowl inside & dog treats on the counter also, so seems to be dog friendly, which is lovely).

reviews.name: Sam H.
reviews.quote: A gorgeous wee spot … the people there are warm and welcoming … A treasure to have in the area!
reviews.fullText:
A gorgeous wee spot tucked into the row: The atmosphere is brilliant, the people there are warm and welcoming and the variety of options sweet or savoury are immese!

A treasure to have in the area!

reviews.name: Camila Y.
reviews.quote: Amazing Iced Mocha. Nice vibe, and they have beautiful Snoopy Mugs for sale 😍
reviews.fullText: Amazing Iced Mocha. Nice vibe, and they have beautiful Snoopy Mugs for sale 😍

reviews.name: Pedro B.
reviews.quote: Great coffee and friendly service. We appreciated the cookie treat included. … Calm cosy atmosphere and gift shop. This can become a new regular.
reviews.fullText: Great coffee and friendly service. We appreciated the cookie treat included. A dog friendly caffe. Calm cosy atmosphere and gift shop. This can become a new regular. Reccomended.

reviews.name: Rachel E.
reviews.quote: Without a doubt, my favorite is the flat white with oat. … Dublin could definitely use more pet-friendly places like this.
reviews.fullText: Now that they're open to the public, we can sit down and enjoy our coffee. The atmosphere is incredibly calm and tranquil, and the coffee is simply delicious. Without a doubt, my favorite is the flat white with oat. What I find particularly intriguing is their welcoming attitude towards our furry friends. Dublin could definitely use more pet-friendly places like this. I absolutely adore Black Sheep, and I believe it's definitely worth a visit.

reviews.name: Luccas B.
reviews.quote: Such a lovely spot with amazing food and coffee. For sure we'll be back for more treats!! Highly recommend it ❤️
reviews.fullText: Such a lovely spot with amazing food and coffee. For sure we'll be back for more treats!! Highly recommend it ❤️

reviews.name: Ingrid G.
reviews.quote: Absolutely the best coffee I've tried in Dublin! Congrats, guys ❤️
reviews.fullText: Cozy place and a good costumer service. Absolutely the best coffee I've tried in Dublin! Congrats, guys ❤️
reviews.ownerReply: Muito obrigada! Até a próxima! xxx

reviews.name: Sanghamitra C.
reviews.quote: I tried the chicken mayo bagel and it was great. You can find all sorts of coffee and request for your non dairy milk as well. The staff is really kind too.
reviews.fullText: A very cosy cafe located close to Dundrum business park. This coffee shop has a lot good options and you will find some vegetarian options too. Black sheep has some lunch deals - salads, soup etc. the food is quite tasty, I tried the chicken mayo bagel and it was great. You can find all sorts of coffee and request for your non dairy milk as well. The staff is really kind too. There is very limited seating available - some tables outside and one inside for a max of two people but must try the cafe for its food and coffee!

reviews.name: Manisha C.
reviews.quote: I go there every morning to get myself a dose of Cappuccino. … You should try their Iced Mocha too! It's delicious 😋
reviews.fullText: Great vibe of the place with lovely staff and amazing ambience. I go there every morning to get myself a dose of Cappuccino. One reason to wake up happy the next day is to know that I will go back to Black Sheep in the morning to treat myself with their Coffee. You should try their Iced Mocha too! It's delicious 😋

reviews.name: Aaron H.
reviews.quote: One of my favorite coffee shops in Dublin. Friendly staff, excellent coffee, and a welcoming atmosphere
reviews.fullText: One of my favorite coffee shops in Dublin. Friendly staff, excellent coffee, and a welcoming atmosphere

Food options are all beautiful and consistently tasty.

Staff is very nice.

reviews.fullText: I love this place. If you are visiting Dublin, don´t miss the opportunity to come to this original and cosy cafe. You can find here the best coffee and amazing pastries. If you can't decide between coffee and cake, why not have both? Additionally, they have vegan options! You´ll love it.

notOnSite.name: Marlon F.
notOnSite.quote: The Black Sheep Coffee offers a delightful blend of cozy ambiance, delectable food, and exceptional service. The environment is inviting with its rustic decor and warm lighting, making it perfect for both catching up with friends or enjoying a quiet moment alone. Their food selection is diverse, featuring flavorful options ranging from savory sandwiches to indulgent desserts, all crafted with quality ingredients. The service is attentive and friendly, adding to the overall pleasant experience. The Black Sheep Coffee is a definite must-visit.
